templates.why_chosen: VM1's red Page-Out path (steps 0-2) and VM2's slate Map-In path (steps 3-4) mirror around one shared HPA box, the same physical page moving from one VM's ownership to the other's.
templates.what_to_learn: Mirror two sides as a reclaim sequence and its inverse remap sequence, both numbered and both meeting at one shared physical-resource box in the centre, so the figure argues reuse rather than copying; add a second colour cue beyond red/slate, since only one accent colour marks the highlighted VM path here.
